name: Midnight Terror
source: A young man and a loved one travel together to Tokyo for the latter's piano concert. Despite police warnings about the escape of a maniacal killer, the young man doesn’t seem to take it seriously, and the night turns into a nightmare. The maniac puts them through a trial that pushes the boundaries of their relationship.
